results.note: Destatis press release of 30 Oct 2026: 'Gross domestic product in the 3rd quarter of 2026 up 0.2% on the previous quarter' (price-, seasonally and calendar-adjusted).
Destatis' first estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts Q3 2026 GDP at +0.2% on the previous quarter, which is not negative.
Eurostat's preliminary flash estimate for Q3 2026 (30 Oct 2026): seasonally adjusted GDP increased by 0.4% in the euro area compared with the previous quarter.
Eurostat's preliminary flash estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts euro-area Q3 2026 GDP growth at 0.4% q/q, which is at least 0.2%.
ČSÚ 'Předběžný odhad HDP - 3. čtvrtletí 2026' (050055-26, 30 Oct 2026): GDP grew by 0.5% quarter on quarter (1.6% year on year).
ČSÚ's preliminary estimate of 30 Oct 2026 puts Q3 2026 GDP growth at 0.5% q/q, which is 0.4 or higher.

INSEE's home page key-figure panel shows consumer price inflation (glissement annuel) of +3.4% in October 2026, from the provisional estimate of 30 Oct; the Informations rapides page itself was not opened.
UN meetings coverage of 30 Oct 2026: the Security Council 'unanimously adopted resolution 2833 (2026)' extending the Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 Oct 2027.
UN meetings coverage of 30 Oct 2026: the Security Council 'failed to adopt' both draft resolutions to extend MINURSO, so no extension was adopted in the window.
ExxonMobil's Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 30 Oct 2026) reports Adjusted Earnings Per Common Share (Non-GAAP) of $4.23, above $4.03.
The BoJ Statement on Monetary Policy of 30 Oct 2026 records an 8-1 vote keeping the call rate at around 1.25%, with Takata Hajime voting against and proposing 1.5%.

The Constitutional Court's news list has only one item dated 29–30 Oct (29 Oct, the hearing schedule for week 45) and none on the interim-measure request in the heads-of-missions case; this rests on the Court's own list, ČTK was not checked.
The MF notice set on 30 Oct 2026 at 14:00 fixes the diesel maximum for 31 Oct–2 Nov at 49.45 CZK/l incl. VAT, below the 49.69 valid on 30 Oct (Cenový věstník 113/2026).
